newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates finish unchanged at 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates finish unchanged at 24 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed unchanged from Thursday's close but below the opening levels as liquidity increased by the end of the session, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 24 percent, compared with 24.00/24.50 percent at Thursday's close and 26.50/28 percent at the opening this morning.
In preparation for tax payments today banks bought heavily in the past few days, dealers said.
"Banks had sufficient supply (after buying heavily in the past few days) and also extra money came to the market," said Karoly Barath of Postabank. "Big banks opened almost square, in good position."
"As a result, demand was not that high as had been anticipated," Barath said.
Despite an intraday rate fall today, dealers expected them to rebound in the remaining few sessions of the current two-week reserve period.
